note: Draft register for Spec 045 (design D-05, PR #195 packet; builder of Asset A), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign approved by the owner as written on 2026-10-21. Conventions as in Spec 042's draft register: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-POSITIONAL-RECORD (the pinned hunt_tripartite_test record is the record of the positional test and its strong-sign classes), ASM-HELD-SOURCES (the CISI volumes Vol. 1-2 and Parpola's published identifications are held as the design states), ASM-BLIND-ENTRY (Asset A entry can be performed and attested blind to positional results), ASM-CROSSWALK-KEYS (the pinned sign_crosswalk_master defines the sign identity space Asset A and D-18 share), ASM-D18-FORM (D-18's concordance output, when it lands, can be rendered in the form spec section 2.6 accepts), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (integrity, asset, and freeze-order gates precede any outcome quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-PUBLISHED-ID-LAYER (a depicted-kind label is a published identification, not ground truth about the sign).
